title.zh: 胸廓：一只会呼吸的笼子
title.en: The Ribcage: A Cage That Breathes

text.zh: 胸口这一圈骨头有个难题：既要硬到能挡住撞击，又要软到每分钟能张开 10 多次。
text.en: The ring of bone around your chest faces a contradiction: hard enough to take a blow, yet supple enough to open a dozen times a minute.

text.zh: 12 对肋骨从脊柱向前包过来，一根根斜着往下垂。吸气时它们被提平，胸腔前后一下就深了一截。
text.en: Twelve pairs of ribs sweep forward from the spine, each hanging at a downward slant. Breathe in and they swing level, deepening the chest front to back in one motion.

text.zh: 正前方是胸骨，一块刀片似的扁骨，上面钉着锁骨和一排肋软骨。整只笼子里，只有它是从外面按得到的。
text.en: Straight in front lies the sternum, a flat blade of bone with the collarbones and a row of costal cartilages pinned to it. Of the whole cage, it is the only part you can press on from outside.

text.zh: 上面几对肋骨并没有直接长到胸骨上，中间隔着一段肋软骨。这段软的，正是胸廓能张开的原因。
text.en: The upper ribs never reach the sternum directly; a length of costal cartilage bridges the gap. That soft segment is exactly why the cage can open at all.

text.zh: 后方每一根肋骨都挂在胸椎上，肋头还同时搭住上面那一块。12 对肋骨、12 块胸椎，一一对应。
text.en: At the back, every rib hangs from its own thoracic vertebra and catches the one above as well. Twelve pairs of ribs, twelve vertebrae, matched one to one.

text.zh: 肋骨之间填着两层肋间肌，纤维方向正好交叉。一层往上提，一层往下拉，同一处肌肉管着一进一出。
text.en: Two layers of intercostal muscle fill each gap, their fibres crossing at an angle. One layer lifts, the other pulls down — the same patch of muscle handles both the in and the out.

text.zh: 笼子里装的是心脏。它大半在正中线的左边，前面正好压着胸骨和几段肋软骨。
text.en: Inside the cage sits the heart, most of it to the left of the midline, with the sternum and several costal cartilages pressing directly in front of it.

text.zh: 左肺的前缘缺了一角，正好让心脏顶进去。同一只笼子里塞两样东西，总得有一个先让。
text.en: The front edge of the left lung is notched away, leaving a hollow for the heart to press into. Fit two things in one cage and one of them has to give.

text.zh: 所以胸廓不是一副静止的盔甲。它一边护着心肺，一边跟着每一口气张开又合上，一天到晚没停过。
text.en: So the ribcage is no static suit of armour. It guards the heart and lungs while opening and closing with every breath you take, all day and all night.
